Interface Action

All Known Implementing Classes:
CheckAction, CommandAction, DelayAction, DummyAction, GifControlAction, ListAction, MessageAction, MetadataAction, MoneyAction, PermissionAction, ViewChangeAction, ViewNextAction, VisibilityAction
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Action
A functional interface defining an action performed for a player in the context of an Interaction.

  • Method Details

    • execute

      void execute(Interaction interaction, Player player, boolean primaryTrigger)
      Executes the action for the given player in the given interaction.
      Parameters:
      interaction - the interaction
      player - the player
      primaryTrigger - whether the action trigger was "primary". For actions on components this is true when the component was in direct line of sight and false if overlapped by a different component.
